stories.title: GDP growth comes at expense of consumer savings
stories.take: Q3 GDP grew 3.4% annualized — strongest summer on record — but the savings rate fell to 3.8% and real September spending was flat • PCE inflation rose 3.6%; the Fed held rates and hinted at a possible December hike • Alphabet fell ~12.5% after earnings: 'live by the AI, die by the AI'

stories.title: The Art of the Pardon: How Trump Turned Clemency Into a Business
stories.take: A 'pardon industry' of lobbyists and Trump-linked firms charges wealthy clients for clemency, bypassing DOJ vetting • A $1M Mar-a-Lago dinner preceded a pardon sparing $4.4M in restitution; ~1,600 Jan. 6 defendants got blanket clemency in 2025 • Polls: 88% worry about corruption and 66% say Trump uses the presidency to enrich himself ($2.2B from crypto)

stories.title: Corporate tax cheats, recession deal eats and costly Halloween treats!
stories.take: Top corporations paid an effective 10.4% tax rate in 2025 — lowest in 40 years; ~100 of ~700 firms paid $0, including Disney and Tesla • Discount 'recession' menu deals rose from 22% to 27% of menus • Halloween candy prices up 7.7%; a Hershey variety pack is up ~20% to ~$23

stories.title: Final Days Of Midterm Campaigning, Alaska Senate Race Controversy, Iran War Plans
stories.take: Trump canceled Iowa and Kansas rallies for 19 tele-rallies four days out • Alaska: Democrats accused of recruiting a same-name spoiler Dan Sullivan; Peltola denies knowing anything • The Pentagon's planning chief was removed as the U.S. and Israel weigh post-midterm Iran strikes — Sen. Murphy called the plan 'insane'

stories.title: Is The "PROLED" Macbook Any Good?
stories.take: Answer: yes for the screen, not the touchscreen — the tandem OLED is 'awesome' with blooming eliminated, but touch is awkward, there's no Pencil support, and the hosts say skip it if you don't want touch • 14-inch starts at $2,900, 16-inch at $3,400, maxed-out $15,000 • Also: lighter body, Dynamic Island replaces the notch, and Arc browser sunsets Dec. 22, 2026

stories.title: The AI Trade Gets Spooky
stories.take: Intel plunged >25% on weak Q3, Alphabet lost $0.5T in value, and Amazon fell ~7% despite cloud growth • Binance lost ~$6.3B in the hack (~$3B frozen), with North Korea suspected • Chocolate prices are up >70% in five years, and lab-grown cocoa is emerging as an alternative

stories.title: What’s Driving Elon Musk?
stories.take: Answer: entrenching dependency — Slobodian says Musk's ~$450M in GOP donations (the largest ever in one cycle, a quarter of all GOP donations) aims to deepen dependence on SpaceX, Starlink and X ahead of regulation, driven by an anti-woke, post-human future he believes in • Net worth: $39B in 2020 to ~$1T now; Starlink has 11,000+ satellites and 12M+ subscribers • Musk expects superintelligence in 5–10 years and says 'money won't exist'

stories.title: Are We in an A.I. Bubble? We're About to Find Out.
stories.take: Answer: not proven yet — Anthropic's S-1 shows $16.3B revenue in H1 2026 (14x growth) with its operating loss shrinking to ~$600–700M; the $80B headline loss is a convertible-debt accounting quirk • Warning sign: Q3 growth slowed to 44% as Claude Code cooled and rivals caught up • The IPO in a few weeks is the test — it could raise $100B at a $2T valuation, or a lot less

stories.title: PHP2Shell Won't Be the Last Big AI Cybersecurity Risk
stories.take: PHP2Shell is a critical flaw in PHP — used by ~70% of websites — that the PHP Foundation found in 2024 but left unfixed until an exploit was built in 1–2 days with AI help • AI's biggest role was exploitation, not discovery: work that took three months now takes days • New 'minus-one-day' risk: public patches become working exploits within hours, before users can upgrade

stories.title: The Unforced Errors of Vivek Ramaswamy
stories.take: Ramaswamy's closing Ohio governor ad features opponent Amy Acton's estranged mother — who stayed with the stepfather indicted for abusing Acton; Gov. DeWine called for it to come down, Trump urged keeping it up • A second ad featured a convicted pedophile, a batting-cage ad was mocked and deleted, and the USTA has no record of his 'nationally ranked' tennis claim (No. 48 of 50 in his Midwest section) • He has sunk $40M+ into the race and could be the first Ohio Republican to lose a governor's race in 20 years

stories.title: Josh Brown: If This Is A Bubble, It’s Pathetic
stories.take: Answer: Brown calls it an 'anti-bubble' — 'if it is a bubble, it is the most pathetic bubble I have ever seen'; AI semis are the cheapest stocks in the market (Nvidia at 15x forward earnings, Micron PEG 0.10) • The only credible bubble claim, he says, is an earnings bubble — that today's tech profitability won't last • Advice: stay with scale (Mag 7 / S&P 100); his year-end call is higher, citing an 89% historical chance the year's high comes in December when the S&P is up double digits
